from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, calinski_harabasz_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Load and preprocess data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
X = data.iloc[:, [2, 3]].values  # Select relevant features

# Feature scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

# Dimensionality reduction for visualization
pca = PCA(n_components=2)

# Determine optimal number of clusters
inertias = []
for n_clusters in range(2, 6):
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=n_clusters, init='k-means++', n_init=10, random_state=0)
    kmeans.fit(X_scaled)
    inertias.append(kmeans.inertia_)

plt.plot(range(2, 6), inertias, marker='o')

plt.ylabel('Inertia')
plt.title('Elbow Method')
plt.show()

# Apply K-Means with optimal clusters (e.g., 3)
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, init='k-means++', max_iter=300, n_init=10, random_state=0)
y_kmeans = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)

# Evaluate clustering
print("Silhouette Score:", silhouette_score(X_scaled, y_kmeans))
print("Calinski-Harabasz Score:", calinski_harabasz_score(X_scaled, y_kmeans))

# Visualize clusters
plt.scatter(X_pca[y_kmeans == 0, 0], X_pca[y_kmeans == 0, 1], s=100, c='red', label='Cluster 1')
plt.scatter(X_pca[y_kmeans == 1, 0], X_pca[y_kmeans == 1, 1], s=100, c='blue', label='Cluster 2')
plt.scatter(X_pca[y_kmeans == 2, 0], X_pca[y_kmeans == 2, 1], s=100, c='green', label='Cluster 3')
plt.scatter(kmeans.cluster_centers_[:, 0], kmeans.cluster_centers_[:, 1], s=300, c='yellow', label='Centroids')
plt.title('Clusters of customers')
plt.xlabel('PCA Component 1')
plt.ylabel('PCA Component 2')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
